name: Founder Brief
summary: A calm daily picture of the signals a founder chooses to watch.
outcome: Receive one read-only summary of selected business and product signals at a chosen time.

status.evidence: Every listed connector maps to an existing hstack skill. This is not yet a customer-pilot or paid-use claim.

deployment.live_deployment_rule: Select at least one source and at least one delivery destination.

connector_rules.invalid_live_deployment_message: Choose one place to read from and one place to receive the brief before continuing.

defaults.preview_mode: show the proposed brief structure without connecting an app

customer_setup.summary: Pick only the apps that matter, authorize read-only access in your own deployment, then choose where the brief should arrive.
customer_setup.secret_handling: Keep all credentials in the customer-owned runtime. Agent Recipes never asks for secret values.

verification.preview: Confirm that the selected sources and destination appear in the plain-language plan.
verification.live_deployment: Send one test brief to the selected destination and confirm that it contains only the selected source summaries.

rollback.scope: selected recipe and selected connectors only
steps: Disconnect any selected source or delivery connector individually.
Keep unrelated recipes and connectors unchanged.
